title: Extensions
subtitle: Add capabilities to Nicx: ready-made packs by profession, MCP servers (tools from other programs) and skills with your own instructions. Everything stays on this PC.
restartServer: The Nicx server is out of date. Restart Nicx to use extensions.
reloadFailed: Saved, but I couldn't turn it on in the chat now. Restart Nicx.

packs.readyHint: Each pack installs assistants, routines and skills at once. Removing the pack takes out everything it added.
packs.withMcp: Also install the pack's MCP servers. They run programs on your PC: only check this if you trust whoever made the pack.
packs.willUpdate: Already installed (version {{version}}): installing again updates it.

perm.title: What this pack can do
perm.allTools: An assistant can use all of Nicx's tools
perm.scheduled: Routines that run on their own on schedule: {{list}}
perm.none: Nothing but chatting: no programs, sites or tools.
perm.mcpAsk: Servers start out asking for your confirmation before each action (you can change it later in the MCP tab).

import.title: Import a pack
import.hint: Got a pack (.nicx.json) from someone? Choose the file: you see everything it does before installing.

export.title: Export a pack
export.nothing: You have no assistants, routines, skills or servers to export yet.
export.noSecrets: Keys, tokens and passwords never go in the file.

mcp.intro: MCP servers give Nicx tools from other programs (files, GitHub, databases...). The tools reach the chat as soon as you save, no restart needed.
mcp.noNpx: Node.js was not found: catalog servers use npx. Install Node.js (nodejs.org) to use them.
mcp.reloading: Turning the changes on in the chat...
mcp.saved: Server saved and turned on in the chat.
mcp.empty: No servers yet. Pick one from the catalog below or add another.
mcp.name: Name
mcp.secretHint: Stored values show as {{mask}}; leave them as is to keep them.
mcp.runsProgram: This server runs a program on your PC with your permissions. Only add programs you know.
mcp.testing: Starting the server to test it (the first time npx downloads the program and it may take up to 90 s)...

trusts.perguntar: Ask for confirmation in assisted mode

asks.pasta: Add the folder it may use to the arguments, after the last line (e.g. C:\Users\you\Documents).
asks.conexao: Add the database connection string to the arguments (postgresql://...).

catalogItems.filesystem: Read and write files in the folders you choose

skills.intro: Skills are instructions Nicx follows when a request matches: "how to write minutes", "how to review code". They live in ~/.nicx/skills (SKILL.md format).
skills.needAll: Fill in the title, when to use it and the instructions.
skills.title: Title
skills.whenPlaceholder: E.g.: when I ask for the minutes or summary of a meeting
skills.instructionsPlaceholder: The steps, formats and rules it should follow (Markdown works).
skills.dangerous: They request dangerous permissions: {{list}}. Only install if you trust the source.
skills.saved: Skill "{{name}}" saved and turned on in the chat.
skills.empty: No skills yet. Create or import one.
skills.importHint: From a .zip with folders that have SKILL.md, or from a GitHub repository. Scripts are never copied.

store.intro: Packs reviewed and signed by Falkyria. Nicx checks the signature before installing; browsing sends nothing about you.
